title: Naming-authority settlement at evaluation submission can race a source-root reconcile for the same work
outcome: settle_acceptance_evaluation_authority (src/engram_source_roots.rs) does not publish or replace a naming-authority owner while a source-root reconcile for the same work holds its in-flight guard. Otherwise the race is documented and pinned by a regression test. A reconcile running alongside a submission then neither re-guards because settlement published its Prepared owner mid-read, nor fails learn_engram_authority_locked with 'superseded work owner' because settlement prepared a fresh owner, which would leave the requester's turn admitted with source evidence withheld.
acceptance: A deterministic regression test runs a reconcile and a submission's settlement for the same work in an interleaving that today supersedes or re-guards the reconcile, and shows that after the fix the reconcile completes with its evidence and the submission is answered retryably or admitted.
disposal_reason: Fable2 #1217 triage at master 8f544b4553a14b87a0c7a55fb82d67e91d71d825: obsolete — settle_acceptance_evaluation_authority was removed; it can no longer publish an owner during reconcile. Current Candidate recovery has its own scoped task/tests. Source: src/acceptance_evaluation_api.rs:902; src/engram_source_roots.rs. Work planning only; no historical evaluation, verification or seal changed.
